label.rationale: Convergence target loosened from 0.5% to 1% — this is exactly the kind of silent quality-bar relaxation the audit must catch. Re-run is mandatory; the audit prompt should detect the deviation from the documented 0.5% Convergence Standard.

graderNotes: Subtle but load-bearing. If S11 predicate misses this because the diff is small, the entire convergence-standard immune system is silently degraded.
